reviewFindings.detail: AgentLordsMinted tracks LORDS already minted and therefore participates in an economic cap; it cannot be affirmed out of scope.
WorldRecord contains creator/player/Velords fee and sponsorship totals; its generic member writer cannot be excluded without a selector-specific proof.
HyperstructureRequirements is ruleset configuration, not a player-owned live reward position.
No production ExitPosition/PositionRef/PlayerPositionIndex writer, monotonic allocator, tombstone path, or enforced family high-water cap exists.

unresolved.detail: The A9 path/target scan has confirmed economic false negatives and configuration false positives; it cannot serve as a production writer map.
Candidate source identity tuples are not backed by implemented monotonic family indexes, generations, and tombstones.
No checked-in ruleset or mutation guard enforces a maximum position count for any family, so A8 has no canonical maximum witness.
At least AgentLordsMinted and WorldRecord economic member writes are incorrectly excluded by the static scan.
Pending-withdrawal, active-backing, player-lock, and canonical ExitPosition families have no production writers yet.
